test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 06 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: 400 pears were bought at ₹1230 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹980. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of pears.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SP for 100 pears = CP of 100 pears + Profit per 100 pears

SP for 100 pears = 1230 + (980 ÷ 4) = 1230 + 245 = ₹1475

SP for 1 pear = 1475 ÷ 100 = ₹14.75

SP for 1 dozen (12 pears) = 14.75 × 12 = ₹177

**∴ The correct answer is ₹177.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total pears bought = 400

Cost Price (CP) of 100 pears = ₹1230

Total profit on 400 pears = ₹980

1 Dozen = 12 units

**Formula Used:**

Total Selling Price (SP) = Total CP + Total Profit
